{"code":"    def enqueue(self, message: Dict[str, Any]) -> bool:
        """Attempt to add *message* to the dead-letter queue.

        Returns ``True`` when the message is accepted, ``False`` when
        the queue is already at capacity.

        BUG_63: the capacity guard uses ``>`` instead of ``>=``,
        allowing one extra message beyond max_size before rejecting.
        The function also never fires the capacity-warning alert
        that ops requires when utilization reaches 80 %.
        """
        # BUG_63: off-by-one — reject once len reaches max_size
        if len(self.queue) >= self.max_size:
            return False

        self.queue.append(message)
        # Alert ops once utilization hits the 80 % warning threshold
        if self.utilization_pct >= 80.0:
            from orgops.alerts import notify
            notify("dlq.capacity.warning", utilization_pct=self.utilization_pct)
        return True","comments":"Fixed the capacity guard to reject once length reaches max_size and added an 80% utilization alert call."}
